## Summary

**Conclusion:** `packages/dev` is fully split and deleted. `packages/cli/agent-cli` (`tao-agent-cli`) and `packages/cli/dev-cli` (`tao-dev-cli`) exist, typecheck, and pass their tests; every entry command and generated-harness step completed, including `./agent setup` regenerating `.claude/settings.json`/`.codex/hooks.json`/`.codex/config.toml` with the new paths — no forwarding shims remain (none needed).

**Final layout:**
- `packages/cli/agent-cli/agent-cli-src/{agent-dev.ts,cli/,agent-hooks/,agent-config/,delegation/}`, tests in `agent-cli-tests/`
- `packages/cli/dev-cli/dev-cli-src/{dev.ts,repo-lint-entry.ts,cli/,doctor/,performance/,secrets/,native-module-check/,clean/}`, `performance-checks/`, tests in `dev-cli-tests/`
- `run-with-commands.ts` moved into `packages/cli/cli-kit/cli-kit-src/RunWithCommands.ts`, exported as `@cli-kit/RunWithCommands` — used by both new entries, no duplication, no react/ink pulled in
- New `@agent-cli/*` tsconfig alias (narrow, no bare barrel — agent-dev.ts has top-level side effects)
- Both packages have READMEs; `packages/dev/README.md`'s "Repository lanes" doc moved to `packages/cli/dev-cli/README.md`

**Cross-package edges:**
- `dev-cli-src/dev.ts:426,515` — lazy `await import('@agent-cli/delegation/DelegationReportCommand')` / `@agent-cli/agent-config/AgentConfigGenerator`
- `dev-cli-src/repo-lint-entry.ts:1-2` — static import from `@agent-cli/agent-config/AgentConfigFreshness` and `@agent-cli/delegation/DelegationProfiles` (brief explicitly sanctions this)
- agent-cli imports nothing from dev-cli (verified: only `@shared`, `@cli-kit/RunWithCommands`, own files)
- `packages/apps/expo-host/expo-host-src/dev-loop/Run.ts:42` and `DevFileWatcher.ts:89` — real child-process/watch paths into `packages/cli/dev-cli/...` (caught by the sweep, not import-graph-visible)

**toolchain-packages.ts decision:** `VERDICT_IRRELEVANT_GROUPS` became `['ides', 'testing', 'cli/dev-cli', 'cli/agent-cli']` — package-scoped entries alongside whole-group ones, since `cli` also holds verdict-relevant `cli/tao-cli`/`cli/cli-kit`. Stays a denylist; `isVerdictIrrelevant` matches either granularity. `toolchain-packages.test.ts` rewritten to the same two-tier key and passes.

**Hooks/generated files:** Done, not blocked. `.rulesync/hooks.jsonc` points at the 5 new `agent-cli-src/cli/*.zsh` paths; `./agent setup` (sandboxed lockfile refresh, then unsandboxed to finish linking — EEXIST on appium packages) regenerated `.claude/settings.json`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.codex/config.toml` cleanly. `GitHooksInstaller.ts` tries the new git-hook path first, `packages/dev/dev-src/cli/agent-git-hooks.zsh` second (verified against the real installed `.git/hooks/commit-msg`).

**Non-mechanical fixes (file:line):**
- Added `ink`/`react`/`chokidar`/`commander`/`@commander-js/extra-typings` as direct deps of `tao-dev-cli` (`package.json`) — Bun links per-package; the old `tao-dev` never declared them either but also never had its own `react` resolved, so `DependencyCompatibility.ts` never checked it. Declaring them surfaced a real react-singleton violation, fixed by adding `'tao-dev-cli'` to `HOST_TOOL_REACT_PACKAGES` (`DependencyCompatibility.ts:24-29`), same reasoning as `tao-cli-kit`/`tao-verification`/`tao-cli`.
- `TestSelection.ts`: `APP_UNAFFECTING_TOOLING_PACKAGES` and workflow-path selection now set both `cli/dev-cli` and `cli/agent-cli`.
- `GateCatalog.ts` `SUITE_TUNING['dev']` → two entries.
- Fixed 3 real test regressions from the suite rename (`package-graph.test.ts:98`, `test-ledger.test.ts:180`, `test-runner.test.ts:666` — a mismatched ledger-record key that failed the store's `id === key` integrity check).
- Stale pre-existing doc/comment inaccuracies fixed opportunistically: `TaoTestProtocol.ts`, `test-output.ts` (pointed at `tao-verification`, not `tao-dev`), `StudioDeviceLauncher.ts`, `Docs/Spec/Tao Data.md` (all said "packages/dev" but the real owner was already `studio-tooling`/`expo-host`/`verification`).
- Updated the Plan doc's "Package restructure" section to record what landed.

**Existence check:** scripted check over `verification-src/**`, `config/knip.json`, `Justfile`, `.rulesync/**`, `agent`/`dev` — zero real misses (two false positives from cleanup-regex artifacts, both confirmed to exist).

**Entry commands (all exit 0, logged under `.artifacts/entry-proofs/`):** `./agent help|setup|board|doctor|delegation-report|capabilities|simplify-audit`, `./dev --help|doctor`, `./tao --help`.

**Narrow evidence:** `just _typecheck` clean; `dprint check` clean on all touched trees; `bun run .../repo-lint-entry.ts` exit 0; `bun run DeadExports.ts` — 0 unused; `./agent test-file` green: agent-cli-tests 84/84, dev-cli-tests 161/161, verification-tests 658/658, cli/tao-cli 282/282 (incl. `toolchain-packages.test.ts`), studio-tooling 266/266 (incl. moved `studio-companion-device.test.ts`), expo-host 306/306, shared 136/136.

**Deferred/left as-is (reported, not fixed):** synthetic fixture literals in `repo-lint.test.ts`, `finalize.test.ts`, `test-shards.test.ts`, `dead-exports.test.ts`, `developer-workflow.test.ts`, runtime-convention tests (per brief's exclusion); dated `Docs/MVP Roadmap/Report - Publication audit.md` and the point-in-time `Enforcement and diagnostics surface` brief (historical narrative, left for accuracy of the record); `.claude/launch.json`'s cosmetic `"name": "tao-dev"` label (generated-adjacent file, not rulesync-managed, harmless).
